shell.roleLockedTitle: This module is not available for your role
shell.roleLockedDesc: The {module} module is not assigned to the {role} role — that is why it is hidden from the menu. Contact your organization administrator for access.
shell.roleLockedEmptyDesc: Modules outside your role scope are hidden from the menu.
shell.capLockedDesc: The {module} capability is not active for this event — that is why it is hidden from the menu. Use Settings → Capabilities to enable it; navigation, forms and reports change together.
shell.capLockedEmpty: Disabled capabilities are hidden from the menu.
shell.freeModeHint: Authentication is off — all modules are open. In production the session role filters the menu.

regMail.title: Merged Organization Approval E-mail
regMail.desc: The approved registrations of the selected organization(s) are merged into a single e-mail and sent to the organization's general address with the subject "your registrations are complete — final official confirmation".
regMail.emptyDesc: No organization-linked confirmed registrations found in this event.
regMail.hint: ONE e-mail is sent per organization; it contains the participant table (name, category, confirmation no, status) and the official confirmation text. Recipient is the organization's general e-mail.
regMail.doneDesc: Sent to {sent} organizations ({n} approved registrations), {failed} failed.
regMail.failTitle: Approval mail could not be sent
